title: Animal influence and estimator choice alter interferon-related summaries
design_limit: No anesthesia-only arm; anesthesia and laparotomy effects cannot be separated
isg_panel_status: Seven-gene panel (Irf7, Ifitm3, Isg15, Mx1, Ifit1, Ifit2, Ifit3) is author-selected, post hoc, and exploratory
score_estimator: Scanpy 1.11.5 score_genes; seed=42, ctrl_size=50, n_bins=25, use_raw=FALSE, ctrl_as_ref=TRUE
hallmark_estimator: Mouse MSigDB 2026.1.Mm Hallmark GSEA on signed DESeq2 Wald-statistic ranks; 13,926 frozen features
loo_status: All leave-one-animal-out rows are descriptive influence diagnostics; they are not additional biological replication
inclusion_status: Primary 7,371 Scrublet-negative versus sensitivity set of all 7,461 frozen microglia assesses inclusion within the same cohort, not independent replication
scale_rule: Direct log2-CPM differences, score_genes differences, and Hallmark NES must remain on separate axes
interpretation_ceiling: Exploratory computational association; no causal IRF7, type-I interferon specificity, TNF protein/activity, or mechanistic claim
